text:
Radioactive materials must be handled in a safe way.
What is not a safety procedure?
A
Monitor exposure time to radioactive materials.
B
Store radioactive materials in cardboard boxes.
C
Use tongs to pick up the radioactive source.
D
Wear protective clothing.

options.label: A
options.text: Monitor exposure time to radioactive materials.

options.label: B
options.text: Store radioactive materials in cardboard boxes.

options.label: C
options.text: Use tongs to pick up the radioactive source.
